corpus.title: Evidence Retrieval for Language Model Answers
corpus.text: A language model answers knowledge questions by retrieving relevant evidence passages from a document collection. The answer cites the retrieved passages instead of relying only on facts in model parameters.

corpus.title: Idempotent Payment Requests After Network Timeouts
corpus.text: Clients retry a payment after an uncertain network timeout using the same idempotency key. A database transaction reserves the key and stores the original outcome so retries cannot create a second charge.

corpus.title: Organization Scoped Vector Retrieval in Archived Research
corpus.text: Similar document vectors are retrieved with cosine distance. Organization access predicates and publication date bounds belong inside the database query before ordering and limiting nearest neighbours.

corpus.title: Superseding Evidence Reviews With Retained Decisions
corpus.text: A living evidence review carries unchanged screening decisions forward with their original attribution. Corrected or retracted studies trigger targeted review and invalidate affected claims without rewriting the parent release.

corpus.title: Recent Organization Scoped Vector Retrieval
corpus.text: Similar document vectors are retrieved with cosine distance. Organization access predicates and publication date bounds belong inside the database query before ordering and limiting nearest neighbours.

corpus.title: Photosynthetic Pigments During Drought
corpus.text: Leaf chlorophyll concentration and stomatal closure change during water stress. Plant experiments measure photosynthetic pigment abundance under controlled irrigation.

corpus.title: Automated Browser Authentication Sessions
corpus.text: Chromium browser tests sign in through an authentication form, retain session cookies, reload a page, and check navigation after a redirect.

corpus.title: Plate Tectonics at Ocean Ridges
corpus.text: Oceanic plates separate at spreading ridges. Rising magma cools into basalt and creates new seafloor whose magnetic stripes record geological history.

corpus.title: Telescope Mirror Calibration
corpus.text: An optical telescope aligns mirror segments by measuring wavefront errors. Adaptive optics correct atmospheric distortion to sharpen stellar images.

corpus.title: Keyboard Focus in Accessible Dialogs
corpus.text: An accessible dialog traps keyboard focus while open, announces its title to a screen reader, and restores focus to the trigger after dismissal.

corpus.title: Fourier Transforms for Audio Spectra
corpus.text: A fast Fourier transform converts sampled audio into frequency bins. Window functions reduce spectral leakage when analysing musical tones.

corpus.title: Customer Churn Survival Analysis
corpus.text: Survival models estimate the time until a customer cancels a subscription. Censoring distinguishes active accounts from observed cancellation events.

rules: Freeze declaration and all source hashes before any provider call.
One attempt; report provider/database errors as infrastructure, never recall zero.
Measure macro recall at 1 and 3; no invented release threshold or generalization.
Semantic and deterministic composite library channels use real provider embeddings and SQL.
Other-organization duplicate content must never appear; the date case excludes the newer duplicate.
Page cases are added after recall so the eligible corpus stays twelve.
Only synthetic content; in-process flags only; no deployed MCP, flag change, backfill or rollout.
The synthetic IntegrationContext checks service authorization, not HTTP grant minting.
